question: How did Apple's Services net sales change in fiscal 2025, and what drove the change?

sentences.text: Apple's Services net sales were $109,158 million in 2025, up 14% from $96,169 million in 2024.
The increase was primarily due to higher net sales from advertising, the App Store and cloud services.
Higher Services net sales were also among the main reasons net sales rose in the Americas, Europe, Japan and Rest of Asia Pacific.

question: What was NVIDIA's Data Center revenue in the quarter ended July 26, 2026, and what drove it?

sentences.text: NVIDIA's Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion in the quarter ended July 26, 2026 (the second quarter of fiscal year 2027), up 117% from a year ago and up 18% sequentially.
NVIDIA says the growth was driven by the ramp of its Blackwell Ultra infrastructure.
From a year ago, Hyperscale revenue more than doubled and AI Clouds, Industrial, & Enterprise revenue rose 138%.

question: How many paid members did Costco have at the end of fiscal 2025, and how did its membership fee revenue change?

sentences.text: At the end of 2025, Costco had 81,000 thousand total paid members, up from 76,200 thousand at the end of 2024.
Membership fee revenue increased 10% in 2025, driven by new member sign-ups and membership fee increases.
The increase in annual membership fees in the U.S. and Canada, effective September 1, 2024, accounted for approximately 40% of the growth in membership income during 2025.
